notes.title: Warehouse Simulator Update 0.0.1
notes.content:
Hello, we have been working these last weeks to add a car AI system, to give more life to the roads. We have more updates on the way, like new vehicles and new parts of the map. We would like to know what you would like to see in the game in the next updates, so if you have any suggestions, we will be happy to read it. Thank you very much.

Change Log:

- Changed roads.
- Improved foliage to increase FPS.
- Fixed sound bug with Pickup
- Added car AI.
